strengths: Credible two-page controlled-record structure with identifiers, approvals, implementation, distribution, attachments, and retention fields.
Rendered pages are clean, restrained, and appropriate to an approved operational form.
defects: Most optional attachment and distribution fields are blank, so the record does not demonstrate a rich supporting packet.
The large blank form areas should remain only when the lifecycle explains them.
confidence_limits: No comparison was made with a real organization's engineering-change form.

patterns: Use a controlled two-page form with explicit lifecycle, approvals, implementation, distribution, optional attachments, and retention metadata.
prohibited_content: All identifiers, components, dates, approvals, line references, and change facts.
sanitization: Recreate the form around a new fictional control system and vary which optional blocks are populated.
proof_gate: Render every page, verify field completeness against the new lifecycle, and confirm no false signatures or approvals are introduced.
